chemical_22LR_class.note: A .22 Long Rifle launches ~2.6 g at ~330 m/s on ~0.1 g of powder; the model's propellant mass for a comparable shot is the right order, confirming the impetus/efficiency balance.

railgun_ONR_2008.note: Modelled stored energy 33.9 MJ at 30% efficiency matches the ~32 MJ bank behind the 10.16 MJ ONR shot; peak current a few MA, consistent with the reported 3+ MA armature current.

coilgun_turman1996.note: 20 kJ muzzle at 40% eff -> 50 kJ store, matches lab benchmark.
